name: Ooga Miyo
source:
Minoru's elder sister.
She is a sensible person and has always looked out for her younger brother.

Though she occasionally stops by to check on him, she is now left bewildered by his sudden claim that he can see a "bunny girl."

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
